first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests reducing onboarding and signup friction can improve time-to-value and first-week activation. I would verify those records before committing, then run a guarded simplification test focused on qualified activation rather than optimizing completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test, prioritizing the broadly confirmed evidence that shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention. Apply signup-field reductions only to SMBs, where activation and qualified revenue improved but retention fell 1%. Evaluate qualified revenue, activation, time-to-value, and 30-day retention—not completion alone—before scaling.
